title: Move a rect
prompt: Return the rectangle shifted by offset. Its size does not change.
signature: func solve(r: Rect2, offset: Vector2) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(r: Rect2, offset: Vector2) -> Rect2:
	return r
hint: Build a new Rect2 from the moved position and the old size.
solution:
func solve(r: Rect2, offset: Vector2) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(r.position + offset, r.size)
